note: Charles Mix County zoning (unincorporated land) is set by a county ordinance whose official zoning map is adopted by reference, published only as ordinance text/PDF, with no queryable zoning layer. The county GIS office publishes parcels only (the CHARLES_MIX_LAYERS host at gis.districtiii.org returns 404 for services). Wagner's zoning ordinance is a .doc and its ETJ map a PDF; no ArcGIS zoning service found for Wagner, Lake Andes or the county.
